title: [BUG]  Session-ID launch is not working - Error: Session ID is already in use.
body:
claude code --session-id 736bd807-d4ce-482f-b62f-06fa6a560b2d
Error: Session ID 736bd807-d4ce-482f-b62f-06fa6a560b2d is already in use.

I am not running any instances of Claude Code, I have killed all potential background processes but I am seeing this when trying to launch to a specific session
author: EntryRadar

top_comments.author: NoleHealth
top_comments.body:
Just got this error as well.
Error: Session ID the_session_id is already in use.
I see the Session jsonl file in $CLAUDE_WORKSPACE/projects/my_project/the_session_id.jsonl

I actually had claude read that to extract the key parts of the conversation into a new markdown. Then I started a new session with that.  Not perfect but I needed some of the key information.
Thanks

Edit - I found a better workaround
I used claude -r "<session-id>" "hello"

That started the session back up with no error.
